headline: Committee agreed to explore raising day camp rates, expanding day camps to O'Bear and Dane Street, and adding online registration fees.
summary: The committee reviewed reports on parks and camp revenue, parking, the carriage house rental program, a possible municipal electric utility, and PILOT/SILOT agreements with tax-exempt institutions. Members also discussed state aid, community outreach plans including an October 20th meeting, and school transportation and field use issues.
decisions: The committee agreed to look into raising day camp rates, expanding day camps to O'Bear and Dane Street, and adding an online waiver and registration fee at the start of summer for drop-off camp.

decision_evidence.quote: Committee agrees to explore: raising day camp rates, expanding day camps to O'Bear & Dane street, online waiver and registration fee at beginning of the summer for drop off camp.
